==Description==
This template is used to help date the events of the television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. To keep the site's articles up to date with canon sources, this template will be updated as new information is released.

==Usage==
Use the following code, making sure that it is properly formatted as a [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|reference note]]. For the  televised episodes, "''EPISODE NUMBER''" should be a three-digit number, the first digit being the season number and the other two digits being the individual episode number, e.g., 105 for "[[Rise of the Old Masters]]" (Season 1, Episode 5).
<nowiki><ref name="Date">{{</nowiki>RebelsDate|''EPISODE NUMBER''}}</ref>
